heading: Every prompt becomes a reviewable unit of work
description: Helix turns a single sentence into a stack of small, dependency-ordered changes — each verified against your repo before the next runs.

items.title: Atomic decomposition
items.description: Helix breaks each prompt into the smallest meaningful units so each one can be reviewed, reverted, or merged independently.

items.title: Dependency-aware execution
items.description: Units run in the right order — files, modules, and tests are sequenced so partial states never get committed.

items.title: Repo-aware verification
items.description: Every unit is type-checked, linted, and tested against the live repo before it can be promoted.

items.title: Reviewable PR output
items.description: Each unit lands as a small, focused pull request with a clear description and a replayable run log.

items.title: Persona-targeted workflows
items.description: Helix adapts its planning to founders, engineers, PMs, and designers — every persona gets the workflow that fits.

items.title: Multi-stack support
items.description: TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Swift — Helix works against whichever stack your repo is actually written in.

items.title: Quality-bar enforcement
items.description: Tests, types, and lint aren't optional. Helix treats your existing quality bar as the contract for every unit.
